band_reorder_geometry.scope: Only macro-band ordering, global TM1 trunk lengths and corresponding public pin coordinates change. No intrinsic device, local access geometry, load or electrical gate change. Native DRC/LVS and new full extraction/waveforms remain required.

parent_geometry.scope: Exact non-port-annotation child drawings and actual native transforms. Parent connectivity is independently checked against unsimplified LVS and158 native planes. Does not certify RC or electrical behavior.
